name: Ayurvedic Treatment of Heartburn (Acid Reflux)

sections.diet_and_lifestyle:
About Heartburn 
 Heartburn is a burning sensation in the central chest or the upper chest abdomen. It is also called as acid indigestion. The pain may get often worse on lying or bending down. It is mainly due to regurgitation of the gastric reflux into the esophagus (Food pipe). It causes chest pain, which may radiate to the jaw or throat. 
 Ayurvedic approach 
 According to Ayurveda, Normally the human body consists of three humor (Vata,Pitta and kapha). Acid reflux caused due to alleviation of the pitta humor in the body. It symbolizes fire and features are hot, sharp, intense, acidic, and pungent in nature. It is located in the stomach. Due to increase of pitta dosha there is an increase of acidic content in the stomach fluid. In these types of patient, the acid reflux is more often due to aggravation of the pitta dosha which leads to acid reflux. 
 Differential diagnose 
 Esophageal and heart attack symptoms are same, as both heart and esophagus use the same nerve supply. 
 In the diagnosis of a heart attack or cardiac disease, the patient first diagnose with the unexplained heart attack. A patient with chest pain related to GERD is difficult to distinguish clinically from those with chest pain due to the cardiac disease. Further investigation will confirm the diagnosis of heart attack.
sections.causes_of_heartburn: The normal process is that when a person swallows, a band of muscles around the bottom of the esophagus that is lower esophageal sphincter, which relaxes to allow food and liquid to flow down into the stomach after that the muscles again get tightens. If this sphincter weakens and relaxes at the wrong time, then the stomach acid can move back into the esophagus and cause the heartburn.

A burning pain in the chest that usually occurs after eating or may occur at night 
 Pain that worsen on lying down or bending down 
 Difficulty in swallowing 
 Chronic cough 
 Sore throat 
 Persistent nausea and vomiting 
 Regurgitation of the foods and liquids with a taste of acid in the throat
